description: Preview an order: checks the combination of product, plan, billing cycle, region and options, and returns the price breakdown and any blockingReasons. Nothing is ordered, reserved or charged. When this connection may order (permission orders.create) and the order is allowed, it also returns confirmation (confirmationCode, chargeSummary, valid 10 minutes) for create_order; otherwise ordering.reason says why not.

billingCycleSlug.description: Billing cycle: 3-day, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual.

configuration.description: Product-specific configuration, same shape as the REST order body.

planSlug.description: Plan slug from list_orderable_plans (products with fixed plans).

regionSlug.description: Region slug from list_orderable_product_regions (products with region choice).

resourceConfig.description: Resource values for configurable products, keyed as listed by list_orderable_plans.

name: preview_order
title: Preview Order Price
